scope: Newest-first ME5: three printed deck-selection attacks; artwork and true BREAK excluded.

ruleReferences.usedFor: Tropius Fruity Aroma: physical top6, reveal any Pokemon to Hand, shuffle unchosen cards back.
Mega Delphox ex promo with identical Trick Portal: top9 any Pokemon directly Bench, shuffle rest. Local ME5 printed costs/stats/evolution remain authoritative and unchanged.
Bombirdier Challenging Delivery: flip2, only both heads search one Pokemon to Bench and shuffle.
Official FAQ explicitly allows Evolution Pokemon directly onto Bench with Challenging Delivery.
Advanced Rules3.4 p31 C-11: full Bench ends deck placement without inspecting deck; fewer free slots limit placed cards. Existing semantics retained for top-window Bench placement.

evidence.name: Fruity Aroma
evidence.textEn: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck, and you may reveal any number of Pokémon you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
evidence.textZh: 查看自己牌库上方6张卡牌，选择其中任意数量的宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。将剩余的卡牌放回牌库并重洗牌库。

evidence.name: Trick Portal
evidence.textEn: Look at the top 9 cards of your deck, and you may put any number of Pokémon you find there onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
evidence.textZh: 查看自己牌库上方9张卡牌，选择其中任意数量的宝可梦，放于备战区。将剩余的卡牌放回牌库并重洗牌库。

evidence.name: Challenging Delivery
evidence.textEn: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, search your deck for a Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
evidence.textZh: 抛掷2次硬币，如果全部为正面的话，则选择自己牌库中的1张宝可梦，放于备战区。并重洗牌库。
